results.rationale: The foil-wrapped and nut-coated chocolates remain recognizable, but two extra small brown balls are added. The gold gradient, bokeh and upper-left brown title implement the design concept, while the requested sentence is extensively garbled and the restrained two-ball composition is lost. Malformed lettering and smeared chocolate texture create multiple distracting flaws.

The supplied source is a fountain pen, retained with its black body and gold trim while the requested poster background changes. A bear at right, blue sky, stars, clouds and candy are present, but the required Bear Balloon Party title is garbled. Distorted lettering and claw-like fused bear paw details reduce visual quality.
